items.synopsis: On SRX1600, SRX2300 and SRX4300 platforms, upon configuring "set protocols l2-learning global-mode switching" where 1G SFP is used on 10G port the port goes down after sometime causing traffic drop.
items.description: On SRX1600, SRX2300 and SRX4300 platforms, upon configuring "set protocols l2-learning global-mode switching" where 1G SFP is used on 10G port the port goes down after sometime causing traffic drop. This traffic drop is only subjected to the port where the configuration is applied, thus the other ports remains unaffected.

items.synopsis: On Junos OS Evolved PTX10004 and PTX10008 platforms with LC1301 line cards and SF5 fabric, fabric link faults need to be reported as major alarms.
items.description: On Junos OS Evolved PTX10004 and PTX10008 platforms with LC1301 line cards and SF5 fabric, fabric link faults need to be reported as major alarms. Link faults can occur during system operation and result in reduced fabric capacity with partial impact. This enhancement introduces the new alarm "One or more PFE pairs operating with less than acceptable fabric capacity" to indicate reduced fabric capacity conditions.

items.synopsis: On Junos MX Broadband Edge (BBE) platforms where Subscriber access management service Layer-2 Bitstream Access (L2BSA) solution is deployed, when "inner-vlan-id-swap-ranges" is modified in the presence of active L2BSA…
items.description: On Junos MX Broadband Edge (BBE) platforms where Subscriber access management service Layer-2 Bitstream Access (L2BSA) solution is deployed, when "inner-vlan-id-swap-ranges" is modified in the presence of active L2BSA subscribers, free inner-vlan-id count is not calculated correctly, hence subsequent L2BSA login attempts fail and subscribers move to pending state.

items.synopsis: When Junos and Junos Evolved platform sends two proxied Neighbor Advertisement for default gateway, second one without Router flag and target Link-Layer address.
items.description: When Junos and Junos Evolved platform sends two proxied Neighbor Advertisement for default gateway, second one without Router flag and target Link-Layer address. The second Neighbor Advertisement can disrupt connectivity for end hosts. A proxied Neighbor Advertisement (NA) is an IPv6 mechanism where a network device responds to Neighbor Discovery requests on behalf of another device, instead of the actual endpoint replying itself.

items.synopsis: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms with EVPN-MPLS (Ethernet VPN- Multiprotocol label switching) and VXLAN (Virtual Extensible LAN) stitching , ARP (Address Resolution Protocol) entries learned over a VTEP (Virtual…
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms with EVPN-MPLS (Ethernet VPN- Multiprotocol label switching) and VXLAN (Virtual Extensible LAN) stitching , ARP (Address Resolution Protocol) entries learned over a VTEP (Virtual Tunnel Endpoint) interface are not refreshed by re-ARP (unicast ARP refresh) mechanism. As a result, ARP entries can age out and are temporarily removed causing intermittent traffic disruption. This issue will be restored automatically when ARP entries are re-learnt after some delay(several hundreds milli seconds).

items.synopsis: On EX4400-48F and EX4400-24X platforms with SFP-T (740-013111) connected, the ports can flap intermittently.
items.description: On EX4400-48F and EX4400-24X platforms with SFP-T (740-013111) connected, the ports can flap intermittently. This is related to ports 36-47 on these platforms only, which results in the traffic loss of ~5 seconds.

items.synopsis: On Junos platforms supporting Ethernet Segment Identifier (ESI) based Aggregated Ethernet (AE) Link Aggregation Group (LAG) deployments, Link Aggregation Control Protocol (LACP) does not return to the expected Attached…
items.description: On Junos platforms supporting Ethernet Segment Identifier (ESI) based Aggregated Ethernet (AE) Link Aggregation Group (LAG) deployments, Link Aggregation Control Protocol (LACP) does not return to the expected Attached state when a Graceful Routing Engine Switchover (GRES) occurs on the Provider Edge (PE) device and is followed by an AE member interface flap on the connected device, with lacp-oos-on-ndf (LACP out-of-sync on non-designated forwarder) enabled on the PE.

items.synopsis: vmhost upgrade may fail due to 'Validation failed' when upgrading to freebsd15 based Junos from older releases.
items.description: vmhost upgrade may fail due to 'Validation failed' when upgrading to freebsd15 based Junos from older releases. This does not apply to Junos-EVO.

items.synopsis: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms when GRES (Graceful Routing Engine Switchover) is enabled and any other protocol dependent on Periodic Packet Management (PPM) in non-centralised mode(distributed to FPC's) is…
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms when GRES (Graceful Routing Engine Switchover) is enabled and any other protocol dependent on Periodic Packet Management (PPM) in non-centralised mode(distributed to FPC's) is configured, after an RE (Routing Engine) switchover, the protocol fails to recover, resulting in services dependent on the protocol to go down.

items.synopsis: On QFX5K and EX4K platforms, next-hop updates for host routes in the LPM table may fail when the lpm-profile is configured without the unicast-in-lpm option.
items.description: On QFX5K and EX4K platforms, next-hop updates for host routes in the LPM table may fail when the lpm-profile is configured without the unicast-in-lpm option. This can result in stale next-hop entries in hardware, causing traffic to continue forwarding over invalid or costed-out paths.

items.synopsis: On Junos EX4400, EX4400-24T, EX4400-24X, EX4400-48T, EX4400-48F, EX4400-24MP, EX4400-48MP, EX4300-MP platforms, it is observed that in a scaled scenario with more than three thousand next hops configured, further next…
items.description: On Junos EX4400, EX4400-24T, EX4400-24X, EX4400-48T, EX4400-48F, EX4400-24MP, EX4400-48MP, EX4300-MP platforms, it is observed that in a scaled scenario with more than three thousand next hops configured, further next hop installation fails which in turn causes routes to fail leading to traffic drop.

items.synopsis: On SRX300-series devices, when ethernet-switching is used with spanning-tree protocol enabled, in some cases ARP reply packets may be sent out from a spanning-tree blocked port.
items.description: On SRX300-series devices, when ethernet-switching is used with spanning-tree protocol enabled, in some cases ARP reply packets may be sent out from a spanning-tree blocked port.

items.synopsis: On all Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved platforms, when copying a file to a remote host using a hostname, the device is unable to resolve the hostname, causing the file transfer to fail.
items.description: On all Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved platforms, when copying a file to a remote host using a hostname, the device is unable to resolve the hostname, causing the file transfer to fail. Secure Copy (SCP) operations are not affected and continue to work as expected. This issue does not impact network services or device functionality.

items.synopsis: On all SRX300/320/340/345 platforms, when ICU (In-cluster upgrade) is performed, the first node gets upgraded but the secondary node fails to come up within the timeout window of 20 mins.
items.description: On all SRX300/320/340/345 platforms, when ICU (In-cluster upgrade) is performed, the first node gets upgraded but the secondary node fails to come up within the timeout window of 20 mins. Service impact will be observed as the ICU upgrade fails.
